card.name: Participle after a motion clause
card.fires_on: An -ing word such as looking, collecting or carrying that follows a clause about moving or roaming somewhere. It describes the purpose or action of the mover, in general narrative prose.

modes.label: Looking after roaming
modes.description: The word looking right after someone wanders or travels through a place, before 'for'.
modes.example: When the tide was too high to be on the beach, we roamed the woods<< looking>> for edible berries and nuts to eat.

modes.label: Other participles after movement
modes.description: Collecting, carrying, knowing or seeking after a clause of walking, passing or coming home.
modes.example: Some students smiled with victory as the teacher walked between the rows<< collecting>> the sheets.

card.plain: It marks a purpose word like 'looking' that follows a phrase about someone moving through a place.
